title: Recovered 'relic' tech brought in by security team for telepathic study
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: it'd be like eight security personnel and a huge box, you know, and then I would be in the room with a team of people watching me

plain: Jordan Jose says that as a child at Baker Victory Services in Western New York, between 2008 and 2010, "eight security personnel and a huge box" would arrive, and he would be put in a room with the box while "a team of people" watched him. He tells Michels the box held recovered "relic" technology, which he understands to mean objects of unknown origin, and that the point was to test whether he could reach it by telepathy. If true, recovered objects were being used in psychic experiments on a child.
